segments.speaker: ANNOUNCER
segments.en: Today’s Health Counsel is presented by Paula Clayburg, who is the chief Counsellor at Liverpool’s famous pain clinic: The Wilton Clinic.

segments.speaker: ANNOUNCER
segments.en: Paula ...

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: DO you know what Prince Charles, Seve Ballesteros and Elizabeth Taylor have in common?

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: They all suffer from chronic back pain.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: In fact, bad backs are one of the most common health problems today, affecting people in all walks of life.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The most recent available figures show that about a quarter of a million people are incapacitated with back pain every day.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: And many sufferers don’t know the cause or the solution to their problem.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The majority of our patients at the clinic tend to be women.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: They are especially vulnerable because of pregnancy but also because of osteoporosis, which I personally believe to be the major cause of problems for women.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: I have many women patients who say they have completely given up exercise because the pain makes them so miserable.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: But of course that starts up a vicious circle.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Bed rest, giving up exercise and pain killers are traditional responses to back pain but, although there are many excellent drugs on the market, at our clinic we are beginning to realise the unique benefits of relaxation therapy.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Other specialists in the field make a strong case for certain types of exercise, but in our experience they are easily mishandled and can lead to more harm than good.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Now, let’s look at some of the reasons why back pain is developing into such a unique menace.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: In general, the body is pretty good at self-repair.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: A strain or a blow to a limb, though painful at the time, generally resolves itself.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: But the body’s response to back injury can be very counter- productive.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: When pain strikes, we attempt to keep the back as immobile as possible, which makes the muscles tense up.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Research shows that they often go into spasm, which causes further twisting of the spine.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: A vicious circle is underway.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The second mistake we often make when stricken with extreme back pain is to go to bed and stay there.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Although at the clinic we recognise that a short rest in bed can be helpful ... up to two days . . . any longer makes our back muscles become weaker and unable to hold up our spine.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The pain therefore becomes worse.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Another problem is being overweight.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Anyone a stone or more over- weight who already has back pain is not doing himself any favours: though it won’t actually set it off in the first place, the weight will increase the strain and make things worse.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The British diet could be partially to blame for the increase in back pain: over the last ten years the average weight of men has risen by 11 lbs and of women by 9 lbs.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: So much for the causes and aggravations of pain.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: But what can WE do to help?

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: There are many ways in which simple day-to-day care can make all the difference.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: The first point to watch of course is weight.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: If you are overweight, a diet will make all the difference.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Also, studies have shown that just one hour sitting in a slouched position can strain ligaments in the back which can take months to heal.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: At the clinic we have come to the conclusion that the major cause of the problem is not with the design of chairs, as some have suggested, but in the way WE sit in them.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: It can be useful to get special orthopaedic chairs, but remember the most important improvement should be in OUR posture.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Another enemy of your back is, of course, your beds.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: If your bed doesn’t give enough support, back muscles and ligaments work all night trying to correct spinal alignment, so you wake up with a tired aching back.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Try out an orthopaedic mattress or a spring slatted bed.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Research shows that both can be beneficial for certain types of back pain.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Another hazard for your back are the shock waves which travel up your spine when you walk, known as heel strike.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: A real find for our patients has been the shock-absorbing shoe insert.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: A cheap but very effective solution.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: And you might be better off avoiding shoes with heels higher than YA inches.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Though absolutely flat shoes can be a solution for some, others find their posture suffers.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Finally a word about the state-of-the-art relief - the TENS machine -a small battery-powered gadget which delivers subliminal electrical pulses to the skin.

segments.speaker: PAULA CLAYBURG
segments.en: Our experience indicates that your money is better spent on the more old-fashioned remedies.
